title: Saudi Arabia: Deadly Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport fuel fears of wider Middle East conflict
summary: Deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi airports have disrupted flights and raised fears of a wider regional conflict, as the US considers military action.

image.caption: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport remains closed following deadly Houthi attacks over the weekend (FILE 01/03/2016)Image: Swisshippo/Depositphotos/IMAGO

blocks.text: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia raise fears of wider war
Deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi airports have disrupted flights and raised fears of a wider regional conflict, as the US considers military action.
